column2: The dataset provides HMIS item-wise monthly reporting data for sub-districts in West Siang, Arunachal Pradesh, for {period}. It supports monitoring of health service delivery and progress of key programme indicators. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare, with monthly updates.

The dataset provides HMIS item-wise monthly reporting for sub-districts in West Tripura, Tripura, for {period}. It supports monitoring of public health service delivery and comparing trends over time. The source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, with Central government reporting. Updates are monthly as per the HMIS reporting cycle.

Monthly HMIS item-wise reporting covering public and private health facilities across sub-districts of Yadadri Bhonagiri in Telangana, for {period}. It supports monitoring and planning of Family Welfare/health services by tracking facility-wise service items and totals. Data are compiled under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare, with provisional figures.

This dataset provides the Health Management Information System (HMIS) item-wise monthly reporting for sub-districts in Zunheboto district, Nagaland, for {period}. It supports tracking of facility and health programme performance over time, including provisional monthly figures. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, updated on a monthly cycle.

Monthly performance data for public facilities performing Operation Minor (No or local anaesthesia), aggregated range-wise to support monitoring of service delivery for {period}. The report considers only districts that shifted to facility-wise uploading on the HMIS portal and excludes medical colleges. Covers facility-level active physical public facilities reporting to HMIS.
